app_info.name: HOL Guard
app_info.short_description: Search and fetch HOL Guard security receipts and inventory.
app_info.long_description: HOL Guard provides read-only access to your Guard security receipts, artifact inventory, and workspace status. Search across synced Guard data, fetch individual receipts by opaque ID, and check workspace freshness. All tools are read-only — no mutation, approval, or admin operations.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Guard receipts and inventory. Returns at most 20 sanitized results. The query matches artifact names, harness names, and policy decisions.
tools.output_description: JSON envelope with contractVersion=guard-mcp.v1, source (local or cloud), generatedAt, freshness, results array, and count. Results contain opaque SHA-256-hashed IDs — no internal UUIDs, file paths, or secrets are exposed.

tool_hint_justification.readOnlyHint: Tool only reads from local SQLite store (local) or synced cloud database (cloud). No write, create, update, or delete operations.
tool_hint_justification.destructiveHint: No side effects — read-only search with sanitization.
tool_hint_justification.idempotentHint: Same query returns same results within the same data state.
tool_hint_justification.openWorldHint: Tool accesses only the local Guard store or authenticated user's synced workspace data. No external API calls, web requests, or arbitrary resource access.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a single Guard receipt or inventory item by its opaque namespaced ID. Returns at most 32 KiB of sanitized text.

id.description: Opaque namespaced ID (receipt:, artifact:, inventory:, device:).

tools.output_description: JSON envelope with contractVersion, source, generatedAt, freshness, found (boolean), and sanitized item text. If not found, found=false and text=null. Output is capped at 32 KiB with truncation flag.

tool_hint_justification.readOnlyHint: Tool only reads a single item by opaque ID from the local store or synced cloud database.
tool_hint_justification.destructiveHint: No side effects — read-only fetch with sanitization.
tool_hint_justification.idempotentHint: Same ID returns same result within the same data state.
tool_hint_justification.openWorldHint: Tool accesses only the local Guard store or authenticated user's synced workspace data.

tools.name: get_guard_status
tools.description: Report whether Guard data is available and how fresh it is. Takes no input.
tools.output_description: JSON envelope with contractVersion, source, generatedAt, freshness, and sanitized status fields (data availability, receipt count, last sync time). No sensitive operational details.

tool_hint_justification.readOnlyHint: Tool reports status metadata only — no data access or mutation.
tool_hint_justification.idempotentHint: Status reflects current state at call time.
tool_hint_justification.openWorldHint: Tool accesses only local or synced workspace status.

test_cases.name: Search with empty query
test_cases.description: Call search with empty string query. Verify returns 0-20 sanitized results with contractVersion=guard-mcp.v1.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns JSON envelope with results array and count ≤ 20. No UUIDs, file paths, or secrets in output.

test_cases.name: Search with AIBOM query
test_cases.description: Call search with 'aibom' query. Verify returns matching receipts/inventory.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns JSON envelope with results matching the query, count ≤ 20.

test_cases.name: Fetch non-existent receipt
test_cases.description: Call fetch with a non-existent receipt ID. Verify found=false.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns JSON envelope with found=false, text=null.

test_cases.name: Get guard status
test_cases.description: Call get_guard_status. Verify returns status with contractVersion and source.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns JSON envelope with freshness and sanitized status fields.

test_cases.name: Get guard status empty workspace
test_cases.description: Call get_guard_status on a workspace with no synced data.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns status indicating no data available, no errors.

test_cases.name: Fetch with stale workspace data
test_cases.description: Call fetch on a workspace with stale (old) synced data. Verify response includes freshness indicator.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns found=true (if data exists) with freshness=stale or similar indicator.

negative_test_cases.name: Missing authorization token
negative_test_cases.description: POST to MCP endpoint without Authorization header.

negative_test_cases.name: Insufficient scopes
negative_test_cases.description: POST with valid token missing guard:receipt.read scope.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: HTTP 403 or JSON-RPC error indicating insufficient scopes.

negative_test_cases.name: Cross-tenant isolation
negative_test_cases.description: Attempt to access another workspace's data.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns empty results or not-found — workspace is pinned from token, not from tool input.

negative_test_cases.name: No mutation tools available
negative_test_cases.description: Verify tools/list does not expose approve, deny, policy_write, trust_write, sync, upload, delete, revoke, checkout, subscription, admin, shell, exec, create, or update tools.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: Only search, fetch, get_guard_status are exposed.

negative_test_cases.name: No widget or resource registered
negative_test_cases.description: Verify v1 does not register any widgets or resources.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: No widgets or resources in server capabilities.

negative_test_cases.name: Output sanitization - no UUID leaks
negative_test_cases.description: Verify no raw UUIDs appear in any tool output.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: All IDs are opaque SHA-256-hashed namespaced IDs (receipt:, artifact:, inventory:, device:).

negative_test_cases.name: Output sanitization - no path leaks
negative_test_cases.description: Verify no file paths (/Users/, /home/, /tmp/, file://) appear in tool output.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: No filesystem paths in any response.

negative_test_cases.name: Output sanitization - no secret leaks
negative_test_cases.description: Verify no secrets (password, secret, api_key, token, .env) appear in tool output.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: No secret values in any response.

negative_test_cases.name: Fetch output size limit
negative_test_cases.description: Verify fetch output is capped at 32 KiB.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: If text exceeds 32 KiB, it is truncated with a truncated=true flag.

negative_test_cases.name: Search result count limit
negative_test_cases.description: Verify search returns at most 20 results.

reviewer_instructions.data_access: The hosted MCP endpoint reads only data already synced to the authenticated user's HOL Guard Cloud workspace. Local-only data (receipts not yet synced) is intentionally unavailable remotely. The local stdio MCP server (hol-guard CLI) provides full offline access to all local data.
reviewer_instructions.security_model: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE (S256). Bearer token required — browser session cookies cannot bypass authentication. Workspace is pinned from the validated token grant; tool input cannot access other workspaces. All output is default-deny sanitized through allowlisted fields only. IDs are opaque SHA-256 hashes with a per-process server secret.
reviewer_instructions.no_mutation: v1 exposes only read-only tools (search, fetch, get_guard_status). There are no approve, deny, policy_write, trust_write, sync, upload, delete, revoke, checkout, subscription, admin, shell, exec, create, or update tools. No widgets or resources are registered.
reviewer_instructions.rate_limiting: 100 requests per minute per IP with periodic eviction. In-memory only (not Redis-backed) — documented as a production gap for future scaling.
reviewer_instructions.privacy: No user data is transmitted to third parties. All data flows between the ChatGPT client and the user's own HOL Guard workspace. The local stdio server operates entirely offline with no network access.
